<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">import (</p></div><div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">"sync"</p></div>

<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">&nbsp;</p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">func main() {</p></div><div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">l := sync.Mutex{}</p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">c := sync.NewCond(&l)</p></div>

<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">&nbsp;</p></div><div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">go func() {</p></div><div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">// <span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">调用</span> wait <span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">前需要先加锁</span></p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">c.L.Lock()</p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">c.Wait()</p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">println("Hello, world!")</p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">// <span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">调用</span> wait <span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">后需要解锁</span></p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">c.L.Unlock()</p></div>

<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">}()</p></div>

<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 0px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">&nbsp;</p></div><div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">time.Sleep(time.Second)</p></div>
<div class="outline-element" style="margin-left: 36px"><p style="font-family: Calibri,sans-serif; font-size: 11pt">println("<span style="font-family: Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif">唤醒</span>")</p></div>
